snapshot.title: Next mission card on base screen after debrief
snapshot.description: After the mission debrief closes there is no clear re-entry point. Show a 'Next mission available' card or CTA on the base screen to drive repeat play.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Base screen shows a next-mission prompt after first mission is completed
